label: 🪶 조류 × 곤충 × 패류 도판 — 30·40·60대
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body group shot.
Three women standing in a row with NO GAP between them, arranged left to right.
LEFT: mid thirties. CENTER: early forties. RIGHT: early sixties.
All three dramatic hourglass figures, defined waists and full rounded hips.
LEFT hair: dark brown, long and straight. CENTER hair: black, low twisted chignon. RIGHT hair: grey-white, high tight bun.

POSE — ALL STANDING, three different stances, staggered in DEPTH:
LEFT stands half a step BACK, in deep contrapposto facing the camera, outer hip pushed far to the side, one arm raised overhead so the ribcage lengthens.
CENTER stands half a step FORWARD, in mid-turn with one foot crossing behind the other, torso rotating so one shoulder leads and the waist twists.
RIGHT stands in full profile at 90 degrees, spine long, chest rotating toward the lens, one arm extended down the thigh, head turned to the camera.
CONTACT: LEFT's inner hand rests on CENTER's shoulder; RIGHT's inner hand rests on CENTER's opposite shoulder.

Body fully painted with: hand-coloured natural history engraving, no unpainted ground anywhere.
LEFT — ornithological plate: birds in profile at varied scales, every barb of every feather drawn in fine hatching, perched on stippled branch fragments, small italic binomial names beneath each specimen.
CENTER — entomological plate: beetles, moths and wasps arranged in ordered rows, wing venation and elytra punctation rendered in fine line, each specimen with a numbered pin label and a scale bar.
RIGHT — conchological plate: gastropod and bivalve shells drawn from three aspects each, spiral whorls and ribbing built from tight parallel hatching, cast shadow stippled beneath each shell, italic names below.
SCALE — MANDATORY: on all three figures the hatching spacing is the SAME and no single specimen is wider than a palm, so the three read as consecutive plates from one volume.
No transition or blending between figures is needed.

SURFACE — MANDATORY: bone-dry chalky matte finish, NO wet sheen, NO gloss. Ink lines sit flat in the skin, slightly soft at the edges, in sepia line with muted hand-applied watercolour washes on aged paper cream.
Pigment applied directly on bare skin, pores and skin texture visible.
Specimens tiled densely enough to fill every surface with no broad blank paper.
No panel, no band, no skirt or bodice shape.
The paint ends at the wrist and ankle in ONE thin crisp border; hands and feet bare.
ALL SIX hands fully visible, five separated fingers each.
Nails long almond-shaped, all three lacquered matte sepia.

Footwear: all three wear matte parchment-cream platform stiletto sandals, 3cm platform, open toe with painted toenails visible.
Environment: a natural history library, three framed hand-coloured plates behind, one per figure.
LIGHTING: a single hard key from the front right at 45 degrees, raking across ALL THREE bodies from the same side. Weak rim from behind left. NOT symmetrical multi-sided lighting.
Style: high fashion editorial meeting print study. ultra-sharp 8K. portrait 3:4 vertical.
